sn54.8:1.1: bhikkhave bhavito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti māhānisaṃso || ||
sn54.8:1.2: Katham bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi katham bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso || || 4--10.
sn54.8:2.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkam-
sn54.8:2.5: Evam bhāvito kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādhi evam bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso || || 12.
sn54.8:3.1: Aham pi sudam bhikkhave pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto va samāno iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi ||
sn54.8:3.2: tassa mayham bhikkhave iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharato neva kāyo kilamati na cakkhunī ||
sn54.8:3.3: anupādāya ca me āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati || || 13.
sn54.8:4.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya ||
sn54.8:4.2: Neva kāyo kilameyya na ca cakkhunī || anupādāya ca me āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā ti || ||
sn54.8:4.3: Ayam eva ānāpānasatisamādhi sādhukam manasi kātabbo || || 14.
sn54.8:5.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya ||
sn54.8:5.3: ayam eva anāpānasatisamādhi sādhukaṃ manasi kātabbo || || 15.
sn54.8:6.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:6.3: ayam eva ānāpānasatisamādhi sādhukam manasi kātabbo || || 16.
sn54.8:7.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:7.3: ayam eva ānāpānasatisamādhi sādhukam manasi kātabbo || || 17.
sn54.8:8.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:8.2: Appaṭikkūle ca paṭikkūle ca paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti ||
sn54.8:9.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:9.2: Paṭikkūle ca appaṭikkūle ca appatikkūlasaññī vihareyyan ti ||
sn54.8:10.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:10.2: Appaṭikkūlañca patikkūlañca tad ubhayam abhinivajjetvā upekhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno ti ||
sn54.8:11.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:11.2: Vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja vihareyyanti ||
sn54.8:12.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi akaṅkheyya
sn54.8:12.2: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattam sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijam pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja vihareyyanti ||
sn54.8:13.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi akaṅkheyya
sn54.8:13.2: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno sukhaṃ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeyyaṃ yan tam ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja vihareyyan ti || ||
sn54.8:14.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya ||
sn54.8:14.2: Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva domanassānam atthagamā adukkham asukham upekhāsatiparisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn54.8:15.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:15.2: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānam atthagamā nānattasaññānam amanasikārā Ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanam upasampajja vihareyyan ti ||
sn54.8:16.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya ||
sn54.8:16.2: Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanam upasampajja vihareyyan ti ||
sn54.8:17.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya ||
sn54.8:17.2: Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñci ākiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja vihareyyan ti ||
sn54.8:18.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya.
sn54.8:18.2: Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanam upasampajja vihareyyan ti ||
sn54.8:18.3: ayam eva ānāpānasamadhi sādhukam manasi kātabbo || || 28.
sn54.8:19.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave bhikkhu ce pi ākaṅkheyya ||
sn54.8:19.2: Sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatānaṃ samatikkamma saññavedayitanirodham upasampajja vihareyyan ti || ||
sn54.8:19.3: Ayam eva ānāpānasatisamādhi sādhukam manasi kātabbo || || 29.
sn54.8:20.1: Evam bhāvite kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatisamādimhi evam bahulīkate sukhañ ce vedanaṃ vediyati Sā aniccā ti pajānāti || Anajjhositā ti pajānāti || Anabhinanditā ti pajānāti ||
sn54.8:20.2: dukkhañ ce vedanaṃ vediyati || Sā aniccā ti pajānāti || Anajjhositā ti pajānāti || Anabhinanditā ti pajānāti ||
sn54.8:20.3: adukkhaṃ asukhañ ce vedanam vediyati Sā aniccā ti pajānāti || Anajjhositā ti pajānāti || Anabhinanditā ti pajānāti || || 30.
sn54.8:21.1: So sukhañ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaṃyutto nām vediyati ||
sn54.8:21.2: dukkhañ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaṃyutto nam vediyati ||
sn54.8:21.3: adukkham asukhañ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaṃyutto naṃ vediyati || ||
sn54.8:21.4: So kāyapariyantikam vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikam vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || ||
sn54.8:21.5: Kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantī ti pajānāti || || 31.
sn54.8:22.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca paticca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telapadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn54.8:22.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya ||
sn54.8:22.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikam vedanaṃ vediyamāno Kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī ti pajānāti || jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno Jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti || ||
sn54.8:22.4: Kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantī ti pajānātī
